scope: RAM measurement intent with explicit callback doubles; no HTTP32 or database claim

results.case: Double confirmation sends one write and retains one key
Lost ACK is reconciled by reading the same key without a replay
Ambiguous failure blocks both a fresh key and blind retry
Missing readback permits only an explicit retry with the same payload and key
Changing a payload after an uncertain result does not allocate another key
A confirmed operation requires an explicit new-intent action for another key
Readback of different persisted values is a visible conflict, not an overwrite
Session change during a write discards its late result and operation intent
Invalidating controls synchronously prevents the write from being sent
Failure of the readback retains uncertainty instead of replacing a saved fact with empty state
